verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS design tool like Figma, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'usage data' and library analytics endpoints are about admins reading component usage, not users disabling tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
